key_points.en: We will learn how to express our ideas formally and precisely and concisely. This will require learning some new terminology and notation, all the while thinking and writing in a more formal way.
key_points.zh: 我们将学习如何以形式化、精确且简洁的方式表达思想；为此需要掌握新的术语与记号，并以更形式化的方式思考与书写。

key_points.en: Keep this in mind throughout this chapter: You are learning a language. Some of this material will seem difficult, some will seem boring, and some might seem both! But this is all essential.
key_points.zh: 整章请记住：你在学习一门语言。有些内容看似困难，有些看似枯燥，有些甚至两者兼有；但这些都至关重要。

key_points.en: In the meantime, we will be much more formal and pedantic with our language. If we don't force ourselves to do this now, we won't truly all speak the same mathematical language.
key_points.zh: 在此阶段，我们的语言会格外正式乃至刻板；若现在不严格要求自己，将来便无法真正使用同一套数学语言。

key_points.en: Definition 4.2.1. A mathematical statement (or proposition or logical statement) is a grammatically correct sentence (or string of sentences), composed of English words/symbols and mathematical symbols that has exactly one truth value, either True or False.
key_points.zh: 定义 4.2.1. 数学语句（亦称命题、逻辑语句）是一句语法正确的句子（或句子串），由自然语言词语/符号与数学符号构成，且恰有一个真值——为真或为假。

key_points.en: The sentence 'x^2 - 1 = 0' is not a mathematical statement, despite being composed entirely of mathematical symbols. This type of sentence will be referred to later as a variable proposition: its truth depends on a variable inside the sentence.
key_points.zh: 句“x^2 - 1 = 0”虽完全由数学符号构成，却不是数学语句；这类句子称为变元命题（谓词）：其真值依赖句中的变量。

key_points.en: We might not know the truth value for a given statement, even though we can be sure that there is only one such value. The Goldbach Conjecture is such an example: nobody knows yet whether it is True or False, but only one of those truth values applies.
key_points.zh: 我们可能不知道某语句的真值，却可确信它只有一个真值。哥德巴赫猜想即为例：至今无人知其真假，但二者必居其一，故它仍是数学语句。

key_points.en: Self-referential sentences like 'This sentence is False' are quite bizarre and can produce paradoxes; our definition disallows them as mathematical statements.
key_points.zh: “本句为假”这类自指语句会产生悖论，行为极不规范；定义将其排除在数学语句之外。

key_points.en: To define a variable proposition: (1) give it a letter name (like P); (2) indicate its dependence on some variables; (3) put quotes around the actual proposition; (4) do not include any new letters that have no meaning within the proposition.
key_points.zh: 定义变元命题的规范格式：(1) 用大写字母命名（如 P）；(2) 标明它依赖哪些变量；(3) 命题本身加引号；(4) 不得出现命题内无意义的新字母。

key_points.en: 'There is a real number y such that y = x^3 for every real number x' is False, whereas 'For every real number x there is a real number y such that y = x^3' is True. They contain exactly the same words and symbols, but in a different order.
key_points.zh: “存在实数 y 使得对每个实数 x 都有 y=x^3”为假，而“对每个实数 x 都存在实数 y 使 y=x^3”为真；二者用词与符号完全相同，只是次序不同。

sections.title_zh: 量词：存在量词与全称量词

key_points.en: Definition 4.3.1. The symbol '∀' stands for 'for all'; the symbol '∃' stands for 'there exists'. We call '∀' the universal quantifier and '∃' the existential quantifier.
key_points.zh: 定义 4.3.1. 符号“∀”表示“对所有”，称为全称量词；符号“∃”表示“存在”，称为存在量词。

key_points.en: The helping phrase 'such that' always follows an existential quantification, and only such a quantification. The misplacement of 'such that' led to a statement with the exact opposite meaning as what was originally intended.
key_points.zh: 辅助短语“such that（使得）”只应紧跟存在量词之后；若错置于全称量词之后，会得到与原意恰好相反的含义。

key_points.en: The order of quantifiers dictates when to consider variables as fixed. The initial quantification '∀n ∈ X' serves to fix a particular value of n; afterwards '∃a,b ∈ P' depends on that fixed, but arbitrary, value of n. Those values a,b might depend on n.
key_points.zh: 量词次序决定变量何时被“固定”。形如“∀n∈X. ∃a,b∈P”的语句中，先任意取定 n，a、b 可随 n 而变化；交换量词次序会改变含义。

key_points.en: The Goldbach Conjecture 'Any even natural number ≥ 4 can be written as the sum of two primes' is written ∀n ∈ X. ∃a,b ∈ P. Q(n,a,b), where X is the set of even naturals except 2 and P the set of primes.
key_points.zh: 哥德巴赫猜想“每个≥4的偶数都可表为两素数之和”写作 ∀n∈X. ∃a,b∈P. Q(n,a,b)，其中 X 为除2外的偶数集，P 为素数集。

key_points.en: We must specify a set whenever we use quantifiers. The sentence ∀x. x^2 ≥ 0 may 'look true' but it is meaningless: we must know where x comes from. Context really matters; it can change the truth value of a statement.
key_points.zh: 使用量词时必须指定论域集合。“∀x. x^2≥0”看似为真实则无意义；论域不同（如实数 R 与复数 C）会使同一语句真值不同。

sections.title_zh: 含量词语句的逻辑否定

key_points.en: ¬∀x ∈ S. R(x) is logically equivalent to ∃x ∈ S. ¬R(x). If it's False that every element x ∈ S satisfies R, it must be that at least one element does not satisfy R.
key_points.zh: ¬∀x∈S. R(x) ⟺ ∃x∈S. ¬R(x)。若“每个 x∈S 都满足 R”为假，则必存在某个 x∈S 不满足 R。

key_points.en: ¬∃x ∈ S. R(x) is logically equivalent to ∀x ∈ S. ¬R(x). To disprove an existential claim we show that any value of x fails to satisfy R.
key_points.zh: ¬∃x∈S. R(x) ⟺ ∀x∈S. ¬R(x)。要否定存在性断言，须证明对任意 x 都不满足 R。

key_points.en: To negate a statement composed only of quantifiers and variable propositions, just switch every '∀' to '∃' and vice-versa, and negate the propositions. Don't alter any of the sets over which we quantify.
key_points.zh: 否定仅含量词与变元命题的语句时：把每个“∀”换成“∃”、每个“∃”换成“∀”，再否定末尾命题；不要改变论域集合本身。

key_points.en: Don't change the quantification set! When negating ∀b ∈ T. P(b), we obtain ∃b ∈ T. ¬P(b); the original claim only asserted something about elements of T, so its negation does only that as well.
key_points.zh: 否定时不要改变论域！否定“∀b∈T. P(b)”得到“∃b∈T. ¬P(b)”，仍在同一集合 T 内，不能跑到 T 之外找反例。

key_points.en: The Law of the Excluded Middle: every claim is True or False, so there is no middle ground between those two sides; that middle is excluded. It is an axiom widely adopted in most of mathematics.
key_points.zh: 排中律：每个断言非真即假，二者之间不存在中间地带；它是大部分数学所采用的一条公理。

key_points.en: Proposition 4.4.1. There exist real numbers a,b, both irrational, such that a^b is rational. Proof: (√2)^√2 is either rational or irrational; in either case we can produce the required pair. This is a non-constructive proof.
key_points.zh: 命题 4.4.1. 存在两个无理数 a,b 使 a^b 为有理数。证明：(√2)^√2 要么有理、要么无理；两种情形下都能凑出所需的一对 (a,b)。这是一个非构造性证明。

key_points.en: Definition 4.5.1. We use '∧' between two statements to mean 'and' (conjunction). The truth value of 'P ∧ Q' is True when both P and Q are true, and False otherwise.
key_points.zh: 定义 4.5.1. 用“∧”表示“且”（合取）。P∧Q 当且仅当 P、Q 同时为真时为真，否则为假。

key_points.en: Definition 4.5.3. We use '∨' to mean 'or' (disjunction). In mathematics we use the inclusive 'or': 'P ∨ Q' is True when at least one of P, Q is True (even when both are True).
key_points.zh: 定义 4.5.3. 用“∨”表示“或”（析取）。数学中采用相容（inclusive）或：P∨Q 在 P、Q 至少一个为真时为真（即使二者同真）。

key_points.en: Truth table: for P,Q ∈ {T,F}, P⇒Q is False only in the row P=T, Q=F; in the other three rows it is True. The columns for ¬P, P∧Q, P∨Q, P⇒Q, Q⇒P are: (T,F,F,T,T,T,T), (T,F,F,F,T,F,T), (F,T,T,F,T,T,F), (F,T,T,F,F,T,T).
key_points.zh: 真值表：P⇒Q 仅在 P 真、Q 假那一行取假，其余三行皆真。四行依次为 (P,Q)=(T,T),(T,F),(F,T),(F,F)，对应 P⇒Q 的真值为 T,F,T,T。

key_points.en: Definition 4.5.5. We use '⇒' between two statements to mean 'If...then' (a conditional statement). 'P ⇒ Q' is False only when P is True and Q is False. We refer to P as the hypothesis and Q as the conclusion.
key_points.zh: 定义 4.5.5. 用“⇒”表示“若……则……”（条件语句）。P⇒Q 仅当 P 真而 Q 假时为假；称 P 为前件（假设），Q 为后件（结论）。

key_points.en: The conditional statement 'P ⇒ Q' and '¬P ∨ Q' have the same truth value. This equivalence helps understand why a false hypothesis yields a True conditional.
key_points.zh: 条件语句 P⇒Q 与 ¬P∨Q 真值相同；由此可理解：前件为假时整个条件语句恒真。

key_points.en: Knowing a conditional statement, overall, is True doesn't tell us anything about the truth values of the constituent propositions. From (0=1)⇒(1=1) being True we cannot conclude 0=1.
key_points.zh: 条件语句整体为真，并不能告诉我们其组成命题的真假。例如 (0=1)⇒(1=1) 为真，但绝不能据此推出 0=1。

key_points.en: Definition 4.5.8. Given P ⇒ Q, we call Q ⇒ P the converse, and ¬Q ⇒ ¬P the contrapositive. The converse does not necessarily have the same truth value as the original; the contrapositive always does.
key_points.zh: 定义 4.5.8. 对 P⇒Q，称 Q⇒P 为逆命题，称 ¬Q⇒¬P 为逆否命题。逆命题的真值与原命题无关；逆否命题与原命题真值恒相同。

key_points.en: Set operations via logic: A ⊆ B ⇔ ∀x ∈ U. (x∈A ⇒ x∈B); A∩B = {x∈U | x∈A ∧ x∈B}; A∪B = {x∈U | x∈A ∨ x∈B}; A-B = {x∈U | x∈A ∧ x∉B}; complement A^c = {x∈U | x∉A}.
key_points.zh: 用逻辑重述集合运算：A⊆B ⇔ ∀x∈U. (x∈A⇒x∈B)；A∩B={x∈U | x∈A∧x∈B}；A∪B={x∈U | x∈A∨x∈B}；A-B={x∈U | x∈A∧x∉B}；补集 A^c={x∈U | x∉A}。

key_points.en: Definition 4.6.1. We use '⇐⇒' to mean 'is logically equivalent to' or 'has the same truth value as'. P ⇐⇒ Q means both P ⇒ Q and Q ⇒ P hold; this is also called a biconditional.
key_points.zh: 定义 4.6.1. 用“⇔”表示“逻辑等价于”或“真值相同”。P⇔Q 表示 P⇒Q 与 Q⇒P 同时成立，亦称双条件语句（充要条件）。

key_points.en: (P ⇒ Q) ⇐⇒ (¬Q ⇒ ¬P). The contrapositive of a conditional statement is logically equivalent to the original statement.
key_points.zh: (P⇒Q) ⇔ (¬Q⇒¬P)。条件语句的逆否命题与其原命题逻辑等价。

key_points.en: 'P if and only if Q' means both 'P if Q' (i.e. Q⇒P) and 'P only if Q' (i.e. P⇒Q) hold. 'Q is a sufficient condition for P' means Q⇒P; 'Q is a necessary condition for P' means P⇒Q.
key_points.zh: “P 当且仅当 Q”等价于同时承认“P 当 Q（Q⇒P）”与“P 仅当 Q（P⇒Q）”。Q 是 P 的充分条件 ⇔ Q⇒P；Q 是 P 的必要条件 ⇔ P⇒Q。

key_points.en: Theorem 4.6.6 (Associative Laws). P ∧ (Q ∧ R) ⇐⇒ (P ∧ Q) ∧ R, and P ∨ (Q ∨ R) ⇐⇒ (P ∨ Q) ∨ R. Parentheses may be omitted when only one connective appears.
key_points.zh: 定理 4.6.6（结合律）。P∧(Q∧R) ⇔ (P∧Q)∧R；P∨(Q∨R) ⇔ (P∨Q)∨R。同一联结词多次出现时可省略括号。

key_points.en: Theorem 4.6.7 (Distributive Laws). P ∧ (Q ∨ R) ⇐⇒ (P ∧ Q) ∨ (P ∧ R), and P ∨ (Q ∧ R) ⇐⇒ (P ∨ Q) ∧ (P ∨ R).
Theorem 4.6.8 (De Morgan's Laws for Logic). ¬(P ∧ Q) ⇐⇒ ¬P ∨ ¬Q, and ¬(P ∨ Q) ⇐⇒ ¬P ∧ ¬Q.
key_points.zh: 定理 4.6.8（逻辑中的德摩根律）。¬(P∧Q) ⇔ ¬P∨¬Q；¬(P∨Q) ⇔ ¬P∧¬Q。

key_points.en: Theorem 4.6.9 (De Morgan's Laws for Sets). A∩B (complement) = A^c ∪ B^c, and A∪B (complement) = A^c ∩ B^c. These follow directly from the logical De Morgan Laws.
key_points.zh: 定理 4.6.9（集合中的德摩根律）。(A∩B)^c = A^c∪B^c；(A∪B)^c = A^c∩B^c。可由逻辑德摩根律逐元素等价链直接推出。

key_points.en: Common mistakes: ¬P⇒Q, P⇒¬Q, and P ̸⇒ Q are NOT logically equivalent to ¬(P⇒Q). The only case that makes P⇒Q false is P True and Q False.
key_points.zh: 常见错误：¬P⇒Q、P⇒¬Q、P ̸⇒Q 都不是 ¬(P⇒Q)。使 P⇒Q 为假的唯一情形是 P 真而 Q 假。

key_points.en: ¬(P ⇐⇒ Q) ⇐⇒ (P ∧ ¬Q) ∨ (Q ∧ ¬P). This is exactly the exclusive-or (XOR) of P and Q: exactly one of them is True.
key_points.zh: ¬(P⇔Q) ⇔ (P∧¬Q)∨(Q∧¬P)，即 P、Q 的异或（XOR）：二者恰有一个为真。

key_points.en: Read the statement left to right and negate every piece: a '∃' becomes '∀' plus negation; a '∨' becomes '∧' of negations (De Morgan); a conditional becomes hypothesis ∧ negated conclusion.
key_points.zh: 从左到右逐层否定：遇到“∃”换成“∀”再否定后件；遇到“∨”用德摩根律换成“∧”的否定；遇到条件语句换成“前件成立 ∧ 后件不成立”。

key_points.en: For a variable proposition P(x) over a universe U, define its truth set T_P = {x ∈ U | P(x) is True}. Then P(x)⇒Q(x) for all x is equivalent to T_P ⊆ T_Q; P(x)⇔Q(x) is equivalent to T_P = T_Q; P(x)∧Q(x) corresponds to T_P ∩ T_Q; P(x)∨Q(x) to T_P ∪ T_Q.
key_points.zh: 对论域 U 上的变元命题 P(x)，定义真集 T_P = {x∈U | P(x) 为真}。则 ∀x. (P(x)⇒Q(x)) 等价于 T_P⊆T_Q；∀x. (P(x)⇔Q(x)) 等价于 T_P=T_Q；P∧Q 对应 T_P∩T_Q；P∨Q 对应 T_P∪T_Q。

key_points.en: Direct proof of ∃x ∈ S. P(x): define a specific example y, prove y ∈ S, and prove P(y) holds. Indirect proof: AFSOC that for every y ∈ S, ¬P(y) holds, then find a contradiction.
key_points.zh: 证明 ∃x∈S. P(x) 的直接法：构造具体对象 y，证明 y∈S 且 P(y) 成立。反证法（AFSOC）：假设对所有 y∈S 都有 ¬P(y)，再推出矛盾。

key_points.en: Direct proof of ∀x ∈ S. P(x): let y ∈ S be arbitrary and fixed, then prove P(y) holds. Because the object is arbitrary, the argument applies to every element; because it is fixed, we may refer to it by name.
key_points.zh: 证明 ∀x∈S. P(x) 的直接法：取 y∈S 为任意但固定的元素，证明 P(y)。任意性保证论证对所有元素都成立；固定性使我们可在证明中直呼其名。

key_points.en: The √2 irrationality proof: AFSOC √2 = a/b in lowest terms; then 2b^2 = a^2 forces a even, so a = 2k, then b^2 = 2k^2 forces b even too — contradicting lowest terms. ××××
key_points.zh: √2 无理性的证明：反设 √2=a/b 为既约分数；由 2b²=a² 知 a 为偶，令 a=2k，代入得 b²=2k² 又知 b 为偶，与既约矛盾。××××

key_points.en: Proving P ∨ Q: direct method is to prove one of them. The 'otherwise' method: suppose ¬P holds and prove Q (since if P holds the claim is already done). Or AFSOC that ¬P ∧ ¬Q holds and find a contradiction.
key_points.zh: 证明 P∨Q：直接法只需证出其中一个；“否则法”：设 ¬P 成立而去证 Q（因为若 P 成立结论已自动成立）；亦可反证 ¬P∧¬Q 推出矛盾。

key_points.en: Proving P ∧ Q: prove P holds, then prove Q holds. When combining with an ∃ claim, construct an object that satisfies both properties.
key_points.zh: 证明 P∧Q：先证 P 成立，再证 Q 成立。若与 ∃ 断言结合，则需构造一个同时满足两性质的对象。

key_points.en: Direct proof of P ⇒ Q: suppose P holds, then prove Q holds. We need not consider cases where P is False, since those make the conditional True automatically.
key_points.zh: 证明 P⇒Q 的直接法：设 P 成立，再证 Q 成立。P 为假的情形不必考虑——它们自动使条件语句为真。

key_points.en: Contrapositive method for P ⇒ Q: suppose ¬Q holds and prove ¬P holds (this is the direct proof applied to the equivalent statement ¬Q ⇒ ¬P). It is especially useful when P or Q contains a 'not'.
key_points.zh: 证明 P⇒Q 的逆否命题法：设 ¬Q 成立，去证 ¬P 成立（即对等价命题 ¬Q⇒¬P 用直接法）。当 P 或 Q 含否定词时此法尤为顺手。

key_points.en: Proof by contradiction for P ⇒ Q: AFSOC that P holds and Q fails (i.e. assume P ∧ ¬Q), then find a contradiction.
key_points.zh: 证明 P⇒Q 的反证法：AFSOC 设 P 成立而 Q 不成立（即 P∧¬Q），再导出矛盾。

key_points.en: Proving P ⇐⇒ Q: prove P ⇒ Q (by any method), then prove Q ⇒ P. The most common mistake is proving only one direction.
key_points.zh: 证明 P⇔Q：先用任意方法证 P⇒Q，再证 Q⇒P。最常见的错误是只证一个方向。

key_points.en: To disprove a statement is just to prove its negation. A counterexample to a universal claim ∀x. P(x) is an explicit element x0 for which ¬P(x0) holds.
key_points.zh: 否定一个语句等于证明它的否定为真。对全称断言 ∀x. P(x)，反例就是使 ¬P(x0) 成立的具体元素 x0。

key_points.en: After asserting '∃x ∈ S. P(x)', do not immediately refer to 'x' by name; instead write 'Let such an x be given.' to introduce a particular instance you will work with.
key_points.zh: 写下“∃x∈S. P(x)”之后，不能直接直呼 x；应写“Let such an x be given（取这样一个 x）”，正式引入一个可供后续推导的具体实例。

key_points.en: Just writing 'P ⇒ Q' does not assert that Q holds. To actually deduce Q, write: P⇒Q because...; Also P holds because...; Therefore, Q holds. This is Modus Ponens.
key_points.zh: 仅写下“P⇒Q”并不等于断言 Q 成立。要推出 Q，须写明：因为……所以 P⇒Q；又因为……所以 P 成立；故 Q 成立。这就是假言推理（Modus Ponens）。

glossary.note_zh: 语法正确且恰有一个真值（真或假）的句子；可证或可否。
形如 P(x) 的语句，其真值依赖变量 x；对 x 赋值或量化后才成为命题。
表示“存在/至少有一个/某些”。
与原命题真值相反的语句；¬(∀x.R(x)) ⇔ ∃x.¬R(x)。

glossary.term_zh: 条件语句 P⇒Q（若 P 则 Q）
glossary.note_zh: 仅当 P 真 Q 假时为假；P 为前件、Q 为后件。
对 P⇒Q，逆命题为 Q⇒P，真值与原命题无必然联系。
对 P⇒Q，逆否命题为 ¬Q⇒¬P，与原命题逻辑等价。
P⇔Q 表示 P⇒Q 与 Q⇒P 同真，即“P 当且仅当 Q”。

glossary.term_zh: 必要条件 / 充分条件
glossary.note_zh: Q 是 P 的充分条件 ⇔ Q⇒P；Q 是 P 的必要条件 ⇔ P⇒Q。
每个命题非真即假，没有中间状态；是经典逻辑的公理。
证明某对象存在却不具体给出；常依赖排中律分情况讨论。
由 P⇒Q 与 P 成立推出 Q 成立的推理规则。

glossary.term_zh: 反证假设（为导出矛盾而假设）
glossary.note_zh: 反证法开头用语：暂时假设欲证结论的否定，以推出矛盾。

action_rules.en: Always specify a quantification set after ∀ or ∃; never write bare '∀x. P(x)'.
action_rules.zh: 使用 ∀ 或 ∃ 时必须在其后写明论域集合；绝不写没有集合的“∀x. P(x)”。

action_rules.en: When negating, flip every quantifier (∀↔∃), negate the final predicate, and leave the quantification sets unchanged.
action_rules.zh: 否定含量词的语句时：把每个量词翻转（∀↔∃），否定末尾谓词，但论域集合保持不变。

action_rules.en: Remember 'such that' only follows an existential quantifier ∃; never put it after ∀.
action_rules.zh: “such that（使得）”只跟在存在量词 ∃ 之后，绝不跟在全称量词 ∀ 之后。

action_rules.en: To prove ∃x∈S. P(x): construct an object y, verify y∈S, and verify P(y). To prove ∀x∈S. P(x): let y∈S be arbitrary and fixed, then prove P(y).
action_rules.zh: 证 ∃ 型断言：构造对象 y，验证 y∈S 且 P(y)；证 ∀ 型断言：取 y∈S 为任意但固定的元素，证明 P(y)。

action_rules.en: To prove P⇒Q directly: suppose P and deduce Q. If P or Q contains a negation, prefer the contrapositive ¬Q⇒¬P. As a last resort, AFSOC P∧¬Q and seek a contradiction.
action_rules.zh: 证 P⇒Q：直接设 P 成立去推 Q；若 P 或 Q 含否定词，优先改用逆否命题 ¬Q⇒¬P；必要时 AFSOC 设 P∧¬Q 推出矛盾。

action_rules.en: To prove P⇔Q, prove BOTH directions P⇒Q and Q⇒P; never stop after only one.
action_rules.zh: 证 P⇔Q 时必须两个方向 P⇒Q 与 Q⇒P 都证；只证一个不算完成。

action_rules.en: When you have deduced P∨Q, split into 'Case 1: suppose P' and 'Case 2: suppose Q'; you do not need a separate case where both hold.
action_rules.zh: 一旦推出 P∨Q，就分“情形1：设 P”与“情形2：设 Q”讨论；不必再单列二者同时成立的情形。

action_rules.en: After writing '∃x. P(x)' in a proof, introduce a usable instance with 'Let such an x be given' before referring to x by name; writing P⇒Q alone does not assert Q — you must also assert P and conclude Q.
action_rules.zh: 证明中写下“∃x. P(x)”后，须用“Let such an x be given”正式引入一个具体实例再直呼其名；光写“P⇒Q”不等于断定 Q，必须同时写明 P 成立，才能由 Modus Ponens 得出 Q。

quiz.question_en: Which row of the truth table makes P ⇒ Q False?
quiz.question_zh: 在真值表中，哪一行使得 P⇒Q 为假？
quiz.explanation_en: By Definition 4.5.5, P⇒Q is False only when the hypothesis P is True but the conclusion Q is False; in the other three rows it is True (the false-hypothesis rows are True by the Law of the Excluded Middle).
quiz.explanation_zh: 由定义 4.5.5，P⇒Q 仅在前件 P 真而后件 Q 假时为假；其余三行皆真（前件为假的两行由排中律自动为真）。

quiz.question_en: What is the logical negation of '∀x ∈ R. ∃y ∈ R. y = x^3'?
quiz.question_zh: 语句“∀x∈R. ∃y∈R. y=x³”的逻辑否定是什么？
quiz.explanation_en: Flip each quantifier: ∀ becomes ∃ and ∃ becomes ∀, then negate the final predicate. The sets R are unchanged. Thus ¬(∀x.∃y. y=x³) is ∃x.∀y. y≠x³.
quiz.explanation_zh: 把每个量词翻转（∀→∃，∃→∀），再否定末尾谓词；论域 R 不变。故 ¬(∀x.∃y. y=x³) = ∃x.∀y. y≠x³。

quiz.question_en: Which of the following is logically equivalent to ¬(P ⇒ Q)?
quiz.question_zh: 下列哪一项与 ¬(P⇒Q) 逻辑等价？
quiz.explanation_en: Lemma 4.7.1: ¬(P⇒Q) ⇔ ¬(¬P∨Q) ⇔ P∧¬Q by De Morgan. The other options are common student errors with no logical connection to the original.
quiz.explanation_zh: 引理 4.7.1：利用 P⇒Q ⇔ ¬P∨Q 与德摩根律，得 ¬(P⇒Q) ⇔ P∧¬Q。其余三项均为常见错误，与原命题否定没有逻辑等价关系。

quiz.question_en: What is the standard direct proof strategy for a claim '∀x ∈ S. P(x)'?
quiz.question_zh: 证明“∀x∈S. P(x)”的标准直接证明策略是什么？

options.en: Construct a specific y and verify P(y)
options.zh: 构造一个具体 y 并验证 P(y)

options.en: Let y ∈ S be arbitrary and fixed, then prove P(y)
options.zh: 取 y∈S 为任意但固定的元素，证明 P(y)

options.en: AFSOC that P(y) holds and derive a contradiction
options.zh: AFSOC 设 P(y) 成立并推出矛盾

quiz.explanation_en: Because y is arbitrary, the argument applies to every element of S; because it is fixed, we may refer to y by name throughout the proof. This is the only direct way to cover all elements of S at once.
quiz.explanation_zh: 取任意但固定的 y∈S：任意性保证论证对 S 中所有元素都成立，固定性使证明中可始终直呼 y 之名；这是一次性覆盖 S 中所有元素的直接证法。

quiz.question_en: By De Morgan's Laws, ¬(P ∨ Q) is equivalent to which of the following?
quiz.question_zh: 由德摩根律，¬(P∨Q) 等价于下列哪一项？
quiz.explanation_en: Theorem 4.6.8: ¬(P∨Q) ⇔ ¬P∧¬Q. The companion law is ¬(P∧Q) ⇔ ¬P∨¬Q; negation flips ∧ and ∨.
quiz.explanation_zh: 定理 4.6.8：¬(P∨Q) ⇔ ¬P∧¬Q；配套定律为 ¬(P∧Q) ⇔ ¬P∨¬Q。否定会把 ∧ 与 ∨ 互换。

quiz.question_en: When proving P ⇒ Q by the contrapositive, what exactly do you assume and what do you prove?
quiz.question_zh: 用逆否命题法证明 P⇒Q 时，应假设什么、证明什么？
quiz.explanation_en: The contrapositive of P⇒Q is ¬Q⇒¬P, which is logically equivalent to the original. So we apply the direct method to ¬Q⇒¬P: assume ¬Q and deduce ¬P.
quiz.explanation_zh: P⇒Q 的逆否命题为 ¬Q⇒¬P，二者逻辑等价；对 ¬Q⇒¬P 使用直接法：设 ¬Q 成立，推出 ¬P 成立。
